# 017-hotel

**Provider.** Booking.com, privately managed apartment booked through the OTA, Italian.

**Format.** Email with HTML and text parts. A green confirmation banner, a bordered details table (confirmation number, PIN, check-in and check-out with their time windows, booker), the apartment block, price, a yellow "not included" box and the cancellation terms.

**Why.** Check-in is a window ("dalle 14:00 alle 20:00") from which only the start is taken, while a late check-in surcharge from 20:00 adds a second time range. The price section prints an inner total label "Prezzo" equal to the amount paid, and a separate city tax of € 6 per person per night (€ 54) that is paid at the property and must not be added to the price. Non-refundable terms come as a bold rate name followed by one sentence. Italian dates with weekday names, decimal commas, and an apartment type used as the room name.
